text:
maria: incident-bot paged me: unusual p99 decode tail latency spike in us-west1, started ~11:56 UTC
incident-bot: Pager: high decode-tail-latency (p99 > 2.5s) - service: /v1/generate - severity: P2
maria: I'm seeing streaming stalls in traces; clients get stuck waiting for chunks. p95 ~ 780ms, p99 ~ 3.2s
raj: pulling traces and node histograms now
sam: @kevin-ml any infra/runtime changes overnight? TRT or flashattn rollouts?
kevin-ml: we merged trt-8.6.1 + flashattn2 kernel shim in runtime image. Canary was ok; prod rollout finished ~11:50 UTC
tariq: that matches when p99 started rising. Checking node metrics for paging/THP issues
maria: logs: repeated page allocation WARNs and some decode worker OOM-ish churn around 11:57
raj: quick latency snapshot 11:30-12:10:
```: p50 110ms, p95 780ms, p99 3200ms, p999 7600ms
```
maria: streaming traces show chunk ack delays; clients retrying streams
emma-cs: CS reporting two customers with UX timeouts; one sync job retried 3x before failing
sam: we should consider kernel/compile interactions — a shim touching compiler flags could change memory layout and codegen, causing larger working set
kevin-ml: the shim we added alters some compile flags (LTO enabled, aliasing assumptions) for fused-attention kernels; it also loads a small kernel module for fused ops
tariq: check THP defrag and vmstat — if hugepage fallback happened we might see more page faults
raj: THP defrag count spiked. vmstat shows elevated si/so and high kswapd churn around 11:56
maria: impact: approx 4-6% of requests hit severe tails; overall p99 SLO breaches for streaming routes
incident-bot: Incident window started 2026-03-14T11:56:48Z
sam: mitigation options: rollback shim, pin previous image for affected pools, reduce max_batch/disable prefetch, or shift traffic to us-east
kevin-ml: fastest is rollback: strip shim, revert LTO flags, rebuild image and push canary
tariq: short-term kernel tweaks to reduce swap pressure: sysctl vm.swappiness=10 and lower dirty_ratio
maria: agreed. apply sysctl on pools and start rollback staging
raj: playbook: cordon worst nodes, drain, deploy new image; will stage rollout 10/30/60/100
emma-cs: notifying customers with ETA ~30-45m for mitigation and potential short reconnects
kevin-ml: building image without shim and LTO revert now
sam: prepping routing change to shift 30% traffic to us-east to buy time for rollout
raj: executing swappiness change on pools decode-workers-a,b,c via ssh loop
``````for pool in decode-workers-{a,b,c}; do for node in $(yq e ".${pool}.nodes[]" /etc/infra/pools.yaml); do ssh $node sudo sysctl -w vm.swappiness=10 || true; done; done``````
raj: cordoning decode-12 (highest si/so) and draining it
maria: watching build logs
kevin-ml: build complete (image sha: 8f3a7c). pushing to registry and starting canary in decode-canary
sam: canary looks stable for 5m — p99 down to ~420ms, no streaming stalls observed
raj: beginning staged rollback: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. will pause on anomalies
maria: paused at 30% — metrics stable, p99 for rolled nodes down to ~480-520ms
emma-cs: customer update: "Hotfix rolling now, mitigation expected within 45m" :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Alert: p99 decreased below threshold for rolled pools
tariq: uncordoning decode-12 after new image boot and health checks
raj: finalizing rollout; will monitor 30 more minutes before closing incident
kevin-ml: root cause hypothesis: flashattn kernel shim + LTO/aliasing changes produced codegen that increased working set and memory fragmentation, inducing page allocation pressure and streaming tail stalls under load
maria: follow-ups: kevin to PR opt-in shim + perf tests; infra to add vmstat/THP alerts; devex to extend canary p99 duration checks; SRE to document swappiness quick mitigation
raj: assigning action owners: kevin-ml, tariq, sam, maria
maria: handing off to night oncall (sam) in 40m. If stable after 30m we'll close
sam: night oncall note: "Rolled back shim (image 8f3a7c). Monitor p95/p99; if p99 > 1.5s, route 50% to us-east and re-run canary with perf counters. Do NOT roll TRT forward until perf PR is merged and validated."
emma-cs: I'll prepare post-mortem email + offer extended retries to affected customers
incident-bot: Incident RESOLVED (mitigation applied). Duration: 37m
maria: creating incident ticket with timeline, perf graphs, dmesg snippets
raj: linking dashboards: /dashboards/runtime-decode-tail, canary logs /logs/image-8f3a7c, sample node dmesg in ticket
maria: handoff complete. last_message_ts: 1805001473
